outline:
The Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining course
The course covers the following topics:
1. The basics of knowledge discovery and data mining methods.
2. The use of the existing data mining software for problem solving.
3. Application of data mining for real applications.
schedule:
Week 1~3: Introduction to Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
Week 4: Data Preprocessing
Week 5: Frequent Itemset Mining
Week 6: Classification and Prediction
Week 7:Cluster Analysis
Week 8: Midterm
Week 9~10: Data Mining Using Microsoft SQL Server
Week 11~13: Case studies on Data Mining
Week 14~16: Advanced Topics on Data Mining
Week 17~18: Lab, Work on Final Project
